name: PT Estee Gold Feet Tbk
summary: PT Estee Gold Feet Tbk specializes in the production and distribution of a diverse array of cosmetic items and essential household health and hygiene products. Its cosmetics portfolio features personal care essentials such as deodorants, various fragrances including eau de toilette, eau de parfum, eau de cologne, body perfumes, and perfume sprays, as well as lotions and hair styling solutions. For domestic use, the company supplies disinfectants, specialized antiseptics for helmets and jackets, air and car fresheners, and hand sanitizers. Furthermore, PT Estee Gold Feet Tbk extends its services to include contract manufacturing (tolling) for aerosol and liquid formulations utilized in cosmetics, household goods, and automotive chemical applications. The company, established in 1978, operates from its headquarters located in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia.
